name: How can I improve bathroom lighting for better functionality and aesthetics?

mainEntity.name: How can I improve bathroom lighting for better functionality and aesthetics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improving bathroom lighting involves a layered approach. Consider adding task lighting around the vanity mirror for grooming, general ambient lighting for overall illumination, and accent lighting to highlight architectural features or artwork. Energy-efficient LED fixtures are a great choice for their longevity and diverse color temperatures. Dimmers allow you to adjust the brightness and mood of the space. Proper placement avoids shadows and creates a more inviting atmosphere.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improve bathroom lighting with layered illumination: task lighting for vanity, ambient lighting for general use, and accent lighting for aesthetics, often using LED fixtures and dimmers.
